nodes.label: ADR-011 Dependency security baseline
nodes.summary: Release-preparation decision dated 2026-08-24: targeted dependency updates within composer.json constraints and locked audit release gate.
nodes.rationale: Initial lock advisories affected document rendering, review panels and HTTP boundaries.
nodes.status: Accepted for MVP release preparation; recorded baseline and test counts are historical
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Constraint-preserving dependency patch baseline
nodes.summary: Target updates stay inside composer.json constraints without new dependencies or automatic constraint-changing audit fix.
nodes.rationale: Patch known vulnerabilities without broad dependency/constraint drift.

nodes.label: Locked Composer audit release gate
nodes.summary: Audit composer.lock, full PHPUnit and frontend build before handoff; scripts requiring database run in prepared release environment.
nodes.rationale: Security patches require verification of application compatibility.

nodes.label: Historical dependency review verification
nodes.summary: ADR recorded Dompdf 3.1.6, Filament 5.7.6, Guzzle 8.0.2, PSR-7 3.0.0, PhpSpreadsheet 1.30.6 and Symfony 8.1.5; audit clean, 151 tests/648 assertions and build passed. These are historical evidence, not current versions/counts.
